audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides read 'Skill' while content win[0..5] read Zed and win[6] reads Diana, matching the packet chart. The page rendered a flat coin-flip next to prose saying Zed owns the first six stages.
audit.why: Zed's Q is 900 range on a flat 6s against a melee whose Lunar Rush is 22s at rank 1 unless Moonlight is applied. Late, Pale Cascade's shield and health stacking outlive the mark and Moonfall pulls at 475.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Zed on rows 0-5 and Diana on row 6, ratings adjusted, every why rewritten to match its verdict. win[N] already agrees, so no content chart edits.

audit.why: Spikes match the kits: level 3 string, level 6 Death Mark against a Diana who only just gets Moonfall, first item, and Diana's inversion once she buys health and resistances behind a 9s Pale Cascade.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is stated only vaguely ('Moonlight marks reset her dash') with no cooldown attached, and the page never says that Pale Cascade's shield absorbs the damage Death Mark later repeats, nor that Moonfall's pull is only 475 range.
audit.why: Riot's text: Lunar Rush has no cooldown when dashing to a Moonlight-afflicted enemy, and Crescent Strike is what applies Moonlight (8/7.5/7/6.5/6). Death Mark repeats a portion of damage dealt while marked, so a shield sitting on that damage cuts the repeat too.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, trade lines and both flagged bullets now carry Crescent Strike's 8s/6s, Lunar Rush's 22s and the free-reset condition.

audit.why: Crescent Strike 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Pale Cascade 15/13.5/12/10.5/9, Lunar Rush 22/20/18/16/14, Moonfall 100/90/80, Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nine fields called Diana he/his, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood and tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists diana as female; lint flagged MISGENDER and COPY_PASTE_BLEED.
